title: Scenario, version 3
description: An explicit operation configuration signed with certificates of the run's test PKI. Version 3 adds the signers and their certificates, the document timestamp, the certification level, the signature policy and a rejection expected from the scenario itself. Non-equivalent configurations are distinct scenarios; nothing in a scenario may be changed silently at run time.

expected_rejection.description: Every implementation is expected to refuse to sign under this scenario, whatever the input, for the stated reason

timestamp.description: Each signature carries a signature timestamp from the test PKI's time-stamping authority

revocation_info.description: The document carries the certificates and revocation data that validate each signature (a document security store)

document_timestamp.description: A document timestamp (/DocTimeStamp, ETSI.RFC3161) is added after the last signature

signers.description: The signatures applied one after the other, each an incremental update of the previous output, by the certificate of the test PKI in the stated state: `valid`, or `revoked` before anything is signed

certification_level.description: The first signature is a certification signature with this DocMDP permission level (ISO 32000-1, 12.8.2.2); absent, every signature is an approval signature

signature_policy.description: The signature policy each signature commits to: `icp-brasil-ad-rt` is the ICP-Brasil PAdES policy AD-RT (arc 2.16.76.1.7.1.12.1)
